purpose: Observed and documented pool identities used to decide whether a route can claim capacity relief. Product, model, client, and vendor names are not sufficient identities.
routing_rule: A capacity route requires source and destination entries with distinct declared_pool_id values, current observed status, and documented surface evidence. Otherwise label the route as preference, quality, or cost only.

operator_action: Recheck the non-secret local labels after an account, workspace, plan, or authentication change. Do not record credentials, account numbers, or tokens. Record current headroom before claiming a particular route provides cross-pool relief.
